prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / production game sprites. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED STYLE AND OBJECT REFERENCE for the garden outside Tomade. Generate ONE square SPRITE ATLAS containing exactly 9 isolated objects in an exact evenly spaced 3-column by 3-row grid. Each cell is exactly one ninth of the canvas. All objects centered within their own cell with generous empty padding, no object crosses a cell boundary. NO visible grid lines, text, labels, numbers, room, UI or house. Entire background PERFECTLY FLAT SOLID MAGENTA RGB(255,0,255), including holes and spaces between leaves and legs; magenta is for transparency keying. No white background or checkerboard. No shadows baked on the background.
Exact cell content in row-major order:
Row 1 left: one medium leafy deciduous tree with visible brown trunk, finely modelled small sage/olive leaf clusters, matching the garden corner trees in the reference. Entire crown and trunk visible.
Row 1 middle: one rounded low flowering shrub with several small WHITE daisies and tiny yellow centers, detailed small leaves. Entire shrub visible.
Row 1 right: one TERRACOTTA POT holding a compact tomato plant with a fine branching silhouette, several small RED tomatoes and small green leaves, matching the two entrance planters in the reference. Entire pot and plant visible.
Row 2 left: one honey-oak wooden garden bench viewed front-on from a slightly elevated orthogonal RPG angle, three horizontal back slats, seat slats, two visible legs, thin dark contours. No ground.
Row 2 middle: one compact HORIZONTAL garden bed: THREE tomato plants in a row on thin upright wooden stakes, with red tomatoes and fine leaves, a small rectangular warm-earth patch underneath them, and ONE little grey-blue metal watering can placed beside the right edge. All these form one complete isolated asset. No grass or surrounding ground.
Row 2 right: ONE single warm grey-beige limestone stepping stone, low rectangular slab with lightly irregular pixel corners, lightly shaded side edge, fine small chips and sparse moss pixels at its edges, no white slab or thick rounded outline, no ground.
Row 3 left: ONE small cluster of THREE grey garden rocks, different sizes, tiny moss details, all in one compact patch without grass ground.
Row 3 middle: ONE small low-contrast green GRASS TUFT of about 6-9 fine blades in three small groupings, no soil, no thick black outline.
Row 3 right: ONE small wildflower clump of three tiny WHITE daisies with yellow centers and thin green stems, no pot and no soil.
Style critical: imitate the fine-pixel garden art in the reference, not the coarse geometric placeholders. Orthogonal elevated 2D RPG projection, same light from upper left and dark thin unbroken outlines as indoor furniture. Deliberately placed SMALL square pixels and coherent small leaf clusters; no giant solid color block leaves. Tree native detail about 140x160 pixels, pot about 70x94, shrub90x70, bench150x100, garden bed210x100. Larger objects have more pixels, not larger pixels. Render the atlas at high resolution, preferably 2048x2048, retaining this fine logical grid rather than blurry painting. Beautiful readable fine silhouettes, restrained natural olive/sage greens, warm oak, terracotta, grey-beige stone, small tomato-red accents. At most a few clear shade tones per material. No blur, gradients, painterly noise, oversize black sticker borders, 3D, isometric rotation, artificial shine or decorative frames. Every cell is independent and complete, generous magenta gutters. Exactly nine cells, no extras.
